jobs.title: Portfolio Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Summary / Main Purpose:**

  

To Oversee and manage specific therapy area and brands in term of development, marketing on operational and strategic sides on Corporate Level.

She/He will be focusing on growing and achieving the business plans in terms of sales, revenue and profitability through effective planning and strategizing basis of the product per portfolio and its performance.

She/He will build strong relationships with key regional opinion leaders across all markets and should be travelling overseas for training, coaching on strategy, and ensure implementation in coordination with local marketing and commercial teams.

The Portfolio Manager acts and is sought out as a product expert resource to provide guidance and instruction to sales team.

  

**Geographic Scope:**

* Corporate
  

**Key Responsibilities/ Key Result Areas**

  

**Business Responsibilities**

  

* Manage the entire portfolio of product life cycle from strategic planning to major tactical activities to achieve qualitative and quantitative objectives.
* The Portfolio Manager will ensure the product progress through the product lifecycle from initial design concept through operationalization.
* Monitoring and controlling marketing expenditure within budget allocation, and its reflection on countries as well as overall Brand and portfolio P&L.
* Liaison and work closely with Operations and Business Development to deliver new product offerings and improve those currently in service.
* Coordinate and build strong working relations with various internal departments as; Medical, Finance, Supply Chain, R&D, Sales, Regulatory, …etc.
* Initiate the registration of products in all countries, proposing forecasts, prices and market shares, and coordinate all relevant tasks to assure product registration
* Prepare all launch activities in different markets and follow up all the pre-requisites for the launch.
* Assist countries in identifying KOLs and create corporate channels to create long term partnerships and alliance with them.
* Develop promotional campaigns and follow up their implementation and reflection on sales.
* Specify market requirements for current and future products by conducting market research supported by on-going Field visits to Markets in various countries
* Assist Country Managers, local product managers, Marketing Coordinators in preparing cycle plans by developing messages platforms, target specialties, and indications.
* Provide the background product training and competitors analysis as well as differentiation strategies to the field force.
* For Team Development of knowledge and skill, you must make good use of publications, case studies, referring Scientific journals and clinical studies etc to develop and serve the new campaigns of the assigned products.
* Make use of all available resources to update the knowledge of the Portfolio and train MIOs on a regular basis
  

**Strategic Responsibilities**

  

* Identifies marketing opportunities by identifying consumer requirements; defining market, competitor's share, and competitor's strengths and weaknesses; forecasting projected business; establishing targeted market share.
* Improves product marketability and profitability and market share by researching, identifying, and capitalizing on market opportunities; improving product packaging; coordinating new product development.
* Support teams on the ground with all strategies & tools necessaries for the success of the products.
* Follow up global product performance and diagnose and solve any deviation
* Organize/Participate in local, regional and international symposia and conferences.
* Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations.
  

**Core Competency**

  

* In terms of Competency you are highly result oriented with strong sense of accountability & ownership,
* High on innovation, having a problem solving attitude which supports customer centricity
* Having an analytical mind with ability to think diversely and understand the big picture.
* You have excellent Business Acumen and Strategic Planning skills for diversified portfolio management coupled with strong influencing skills
* Excellent interpersonal, communications, public speaking, and presentation skills with multitask and Project Management experience
* You are a team player with a proactive and collaborative approach and enthusiastically manage stakeholders in good spirit.
  

**Qualifications, Key Experiences / Functional Knowledge Requirements:**

  

* Bachelor of Science (Pharmacy / Biology/Medicine) and Master’s Degree in Business / Marketing Management is highly preferred

* Have a minimum of 6-8 years’ experience in marketing primarily from Pharmaceuticals or FMCG Industry
* Broad Marketing Experience and therapy specific market knowledge in AFME region is must
* Digital Marketing experience is a plus!.
* 20% of the job will require traveling.
* Knowledge in strategic and business planning will be an advantage.
* Experience working with matrixed, geographically distributed and functionally diverse work groups is preferred.
* Proven ability to build strong partnerships with the business, operations, technology and other key stakeholders is required.
* Experience in developing local product positioning strategies that resulted in incremental demand for product.
* **Must Have at least 2-3 years of Experience in Marketing role in Specialty Therapeutic areas (CNS, Oncology or Diabetes)**

jobs.title: Financial Analyst – Management Reporting & Cost Analysis
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, AZ, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented Financial Analyst to analyse company financial transactions, expenditure, and financial data and prepare comprehensive monthly and quarterly management reports. The candidate must be able to identify cost trends, highlight key financial observations, and provide data-driven recommendations to support management decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyse company financial transactions, expenses, and expenditure patterns.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly financial analysis and management reports.
* Identify major cost drivers, unusual transactions, spending trends, and potential cost-saving opportunities.
* Compare actual expenditure against budgets, previous periods, and forecasts where applicable.
* Develop management dashboards, charts, and KPI reports to present financial performance clearly.
* Provide meaningful observations and recommendations based on the analysis.
* Reconcile and validate financial data to ensure accuracy and consistency.
* Work with the Finance and Operations teams to obtain and verify relevant financial information.
* Present key findings and financial insights to management.

Requirements

* Masters degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum 4 years experience in financial analysis, management reporting, or financial planning and analysis.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret large volumes of financial data.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including PivotTables, lookup functions, and data visualisation.
* Experience with Power BI or other reporting and dashboard tools
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to translate financial data into clear business insights.
* Excellent report-writing and presentation skills.

Pay: From AED7,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
